mapper.select: select t.item_id as itemId, t.language_code as languageCode, t.name as name, t.instruction as instruction, t.location as location, i.destination_type as destinationType, i.bin_color as binColor, i.source_url as sourceUrl, cast(0 as double precision) as score from sorting_item_translation t join sorting_item i on i.id = t.item_id where t.language_code = #{languageCode} and i.municipality_id = #{municipalityId} order by t.item_id
